data.name: Agricultural Simulator 2012: Deluxe Edition
data.detailed_description:
An idyllic grange surrounded by invitingly untouched mountain panoramas and unworked ﬁelds are awaiting all agriculture fans in the Agricultural Simulator 2012. At their very own farm hobby-farmers undertake the daily tasks of an agriculturist: The producing of food, sustainable resources and the delivery of energy materials. Fields have to be worked and farm animals fostered. To work smaller ﬁelds and alpine pastures only machines with less performance are available at the beginning, but the vehicle ﬂeet will constantly be supplemented by more powerful agricultural implements.

Future agriculturists have to invest tactical and clever - the consumption of money by the running costs and seeds must not be underestimated. To realize proﬁt it takes
ﬁnancial and tactical skill. Numerous models of Fendt, Challenger, Massey Ferguson and Valtra, which vehicles are reproduced in facsimile, are on hand. All machines and tractors can be driven and navigated by the player.

Features

  • Vast gaming world with mountains and valleys
  • Exciting career mode with trading feature
  • Market place for animals, seeds and machines
  • Countless economical circuits: growing of crops, breeding, bio gas
  • Agricultural technology of Fendt, Massey Ferguson, Challenger and Valtra
  • Realistic physics
  • Highly sophisticated co-workers AI
  • Day and night cycle as well as varying weather conditions
  • Multiplayer via network

reviews.review:
Agricultural Simulator 2012 Deluxe Edition is a farming simulation title developed by Actalogic and published by United Independent Entertainment that attempts to recreate the experience of running a working agricultural business from the ground up. Built around machinery management, crop production, livestock care, and financial planning, the game places players into the role of a farmer responsible for turning a modest operation into a thriving enterprise. Rather than chasing excitement through action-heavy gameplay, it focuses on patience, long-term progression, and the quiet satisfaction that comes from building something steadily over time.

The foundation of the experience revolves around authenticity and agricultural management. Players are given access to licensed farming vehicles and equipment from recognizable manufacturers, adding an extra layer of realism to daily operations. Driving tractors, operating harvesting machinery, and expanding available tools becomes an important part of progression. Starting with limited resources creates a satisfying sense of advancement as income generated through successful farming can be reinvested into larger equipment and improved productivity.

Crop cultivation serves as the center of gameplay. Fields require preparation, planting, maintenance, and harvesting, creating a consistent gameplay cycle that rewards organization and planning. Farming here is not treated as a simplified activity. Instead, players must think about efficiency and resource management while balancing different responsibilities. Livestock systems add additional depth by allowing players to raise animals and expand their agricultural operations beyond crop production alone.

Economic management plays a surprisingly important role throughout the experience. Running a successful farm requires more than simply driving machinery across fields. Purchasing equipment, maintaining profitability, managing production chains, and making long-term financial decisions become essential components of growth. The game encourages strategic thinking by placing players in control of both operational work and business expansion. Building a larger farm feels rewarding because progress develops gradually rather than arriving instantly.

The Deluxe Edition attempts to strengthen immersion through environmental systems designed to simulate the flow of agricultural life. Dynamic weather conditions and day-night transitions help create a more believable farming atmosphere. Watching fields change under different lighting conditions contributes to the slower, more methodical pace that defines the experience. There is a calm quality to managing farmland while time moves naturally forward, particularly for players who enjoy simulation games focused on routine and steady progression.

Artificial intelligence helpers also help reduce some of the workload as operations become more demanding. Rather than forcing players to personally handle every task at all times, the game allows certain responsibilities to be delegated. This management element introduces an additional layer of strategy while helping prevent larger farms from becoming overly repetitive. Expanding operations gradually shifts gameplay from simple machinery control toward broader agricultural oversight.

Multiplayer support adds additional value by allowing players to share responsibilities cooperatively. Farming simulators naturally benefit from teamwork due to the volume of tasks required to maintain productivity, and having assistance can make larger operations more engaging. Cooperative play introduces flexibility and extends longevity beyond solo progression.

Despite its strengths, Agricultural Simulator 2012 Deluxe Edition struggles with technical limitations that become increasingly noticeable over time. Vehicle handling occasionally lacks precision, machine physics can feel inconsistent, and overall presentation reflects its age. Visual quality succeeds in presenting functional environments but rarely reaches the level of polish associated with stronger competitors in the farming simulation genre. Animations can appear stiff, interface design occasionally feels dated, and technical roughness occasionally interrupts immersion.

The learning process may also challenge newer players unfamiliar with farming simulators. Agricultural systems require patience and experimentation, and the game provides limited guidance compared to more modern entries. Understanding workflows and optimizing productivity takes time. Players looking for immediate accessibility may initially feel overwhelmed by the slower pacing and management requirements.

Even with its imperfections, Agricultural Simulator 2012 Deluxe Edition deserves recognition for the scope of its ambition. It attempts to deliver more than a simple tractor-driving experience by building a complete agricultural ecosystem around farming, livestock management, machinery ownership, and economic growth. The game may not offer the refinement expected from modern simulation standards, but it demonstrates genuine effort in recreating rural business management with respectable depth.

Players who enjoy slower simulation experiences centered on progression and planning will likely find satisfaction in its systems despite technical shortcomings. Those searching for cutting-edge visuals or highly polished mechanics may struggle with some of its older design decisions. However, for players willing to accept aging technology in exchange for agricultural depth, Agricultural Simulator 2012 Deluxe Edition remains an interesting farming experience that reflects an earlier generation of simulation design.

Rating: 4/10
